<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will first retrieve the typical carbon chemical shift ranges for aromatic carbons using the retrieve_carbon_shifts tool. This will give me the ppm range to look for in the 13C NMR spectrum. Then I will obtain the sample's 13C NMR spectrum with carbon_nmr_spectra and count how many signals fall within the aromatic range, which corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons.</thought>
